info.title: Beamfall Developer API
info.description: The Beamfall `/v1/` stable developer contract (ADR-0040). Every endpoint under `/v1/` is part of the stability promise: no breaking changes within this major version; a breaking change requires a new prefix (`/v2/`) with a minimum two-release deprecation window. Each operation lists the credentials it accepts in `x-credentials`. Automation operations accept a scoped developer API key (`Authorization: Bearer bfk_...`) carrying the single scope the operation declares in `x-required-scope`. Client operations accept an enrolled device Session (the `X-Beamfall-Session`, `X-Beamfall-Device` and `X-Beamfall-Device-Secret` headers together), which acts as that Session's Profile with its reveal state. The catalog reads accept either. Adding an operation, a response field or an optional request field is a minor version change, and clients must ignore response fields they do not know. All catalog and session reads are Reveal-filtered and Profile-bound to the key's binding (ADR-0004): a Profile-bound key never sees content or sessions outside its Profile, and restricted content it cannot Reveal never appears. The wire entity is `Media`; this surface is domain-agnostic (no plugin/domain vocabulary).

scopedKey.description: A scoped developer API key (ADR-0040 §2.2), minted by a server operator from the Console with a chosen scope subset and an optional Profile binding. Presented as `Authorization: Bearer bfk_...`. An admin API token carries no API scopes and is rejected by every `/v1/` endpoint.

deviceSession.name: X-Beamfall-Session
deviceSession.description: The enrolled device Session ID, obtained by pairing the device. All three device headers are required together; an integration Session or an admin API token is not a device Session.

deviceID.name: X-Beamfall-Device
deviceID.description: The paired device ID. All three device headers are required together; an integration Session or an admin API token is not a device Session.

deviceSecret.name: X-Beamfall-Device-Secret
deviceSecret.description: The paired device secret. All three device headers are required together; an integration Session or an admin API token is not a device Session.

Library.description: A Reveal-filtered Library visible to the key's Profile binding.

restricted.description: True for a restricted Library (only present when the key has Revealed it).

MediaSummary.description: A Media item in a library feed. Generic, plugin-agnostic fields only.

MediaDetail.description: Full detail for one Media row, Reveal-filtered. A hidden or unknown id resolves to 404 (never an existence oracle).

externalIDs.description: Identifiers other systems use for this Media, attached by plugins during import or hydration. Omitted when there are none.

ExternalID.description: One identifier another system uses for a Media. The scheme vocabulary is open: core names no scheme; plugins and integrations agree on them.

Session.description: One active playback session. Media-identifying fields (mediaID/title/libraryID) are omitted when the key cannot currently see that Media under its Reveal filter.

PlaybackControlRequest.description: A closed-vocabulary transport command for one active playback session. Target and Media visibility failures all resolve to 404 to avoid session/Profile/restricted-Media oracles.

libraryID.description: The Library to scan. Must be visible to the key.

root.description: Optional root path. Empty scans the Library's persisted roots.

BackupStatus.description: Profile-bound backup ingest status for one Library. Paused is explicit so clients never silently drop uploads.

BackupMediaResponse.description: Result of a profile-owned backup upload registered as Media.

CapabilityProfile.description: What the client can play. The server picks direct play or transcode from it.

client.description: A short client identifier, used for logging and device quirks.

PlaybackInfo.description: The playback decision for one Media and capability profile.

decision.description: How the server will deliver the Media, for example direct play or transcode.

positionSeconds.description: The resume position for the device Session's Profile.

PlaybackStream.description: One playable stream. The `url` carries its own stream token, so the client fetches it without other credentials until `expiresAt` (RFC 3339). `token` is that token on its own.

streamIndex.description: Index of the subtitle stream muxed in the media. Absent for sidecar files. A muxed text stream can also have a url to fetch it converted.

durationSeconds.description: Omit or send 0 to use the Media's duration.

finished.description: True when playback reached the end.

eventTimeMS.description: The client clock, in Unix milliseconds, when it observed the position. The server keeps the latest report by this time.

Forbidden.description: The credential is not accepted: a scoped key without the required scope, or a credential kind the operation does not list in `x-credentials`.

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON or an invalid field value.

NotFound.description: Media not found or not visible.

Unavailable.description: The operation is not available on this server.

get.summary: List the Libraries visible to the key.
get.description: Accepts a scoped key with the `read-catalog` scope or an enrolled device Session. Reveal-filtered and Profile-bound: a Profile-bound key sees only its Profile's granted Libraries, and a restricted Library it has not Revealed never appears.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of Libraries to return.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted on the final page.

get.summary: List the Media in one Library.
get.description: Accepts a scoped key with the `read-catalog` scope or an enrolled device Session. Reveal-filtered: a Library outside the key's grants (or restricted and unrevealed) yields an empty list, never an error.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of Media items to return.

200.description: The Media in the Library, Reveal-filtered.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted on the final page.

get.summary: Find the Media carrying an external identifier.
get.description: Accepts a scoped key with the `read-catalog` scope or an enrolled device Session. Answers whether an item another system knows by `scheme`/`value` is in the library. Reveal-filtered: Media the caller cannot see are dropped, so an empty list never says whether hidden Media carry the identifier. An identifier normally names one Media; duplicate imports can share one until a dedupe pass resolves them.

parameters.name: scheme
parameters.description: Identifier scheme, as plugins attach it.

200.description: The visible Media carrying the identifier; empty when none do.

400.description: scheme or value missing, or scheme malformed.

get.description: Accepts a scoped key with the `read-catalog` scope or an enrolled device Session. Reveal-filtered: a hidden or unknown id both resolve to 404, so the read is never an existence oracle for Media the key cannot see.

404.description: Media not found or not visible.

post.summary: Start playback: get streams for a capability profile.
post.description: Accepts an enrolled device Session only. Runs the playback decision for the declared capability profile as the Session's Profile and returns stream URLs, stream tokens and their expiries, renditions, caption tracks and the resume position. Hidden and unknown Media both answer 404.

put.description: Accepts an enrolled device Session only. Records the position for the Session's Profile with the server's resume policy for the Media, and marks the Media watched when playback finishes or passes the watched threshold. Hidden and unknown Media both answer 404 and nothing is written.

200.description: The stored position and watched state.

get.description: Requires the `read-sessions` scope. A Profile-bound key sees only its own Profile's sessions; an admin-scoped key (no Profile binding) sees all. Media-identifying fields are omitted for sessions playing Media the key cannot currently Reveal.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of active sessions to return.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted on the final page.

post.summary: Issue a transport command to an active playback session.
post.description: Requires the `playback-control` scope. Publishes one argument-free transport command (`pause`, `resume`, `stop`, `skip-media`, `skip-track`, `mute`, `unmute`; a skip moves to the next item) to the target session's event channel. Verbs that need arguments (`seek`, `set-volume`, track selection, `play-media`, `display-message`, a previous-direction skip) are available through GraphQL `controlSession` and answer 400 here; success means the command was authorized and published, not that the target device has applied it. A Profile-bound key can control only its own Profile's reveal-visible active sessions. An admin-scoped key (no Profile binding) can control reveal-visible active sessions across Profiles, matching ADR-0040's operator-created all-session automation key model. Missing, cross-Profile, inactive, and reveal-hidden targets all resolve to 404.

202.description: The transport command was accepted for delivery.

400.description: sessionID missing, command missing or outside the closed transport vocabulary, or invalid JSON.

404.description: Session not found, not active, outside the key's Profile binding, or not reveal-visible.

post.description: Requires the `ingest` scope. Enqueues a durable scan job for a Library the key can see; an empty root scans the Library's persisted roots. A Library outside the key's grants is reported as 404 (never an existence oracle).

400.description: libraryID missing, the Library has no roots, or more than 200 roots require selecting one root.

500.description: A scan job could not be enqueued. Jobs queued for earlier roots before the failure stay queued and are listed in `jobIDs` (possibly empty).

get.summary: Read backup ingest status for one Library.
get.description: Requires the `backup` scope and a Profile-bound key. Returns the caller Profile's pause/quota state for the target Library; paused state is explicit so a client can surface that backup is stopped instead of silently dropping uploads.

500.description: Backup status could not be read due to an internal failure.

post.summary: Upload one profile-owned backup Media blob.
post.description: Requires the `backup` scope and a Profile-bound key. The request is multipart/form-data with `libraryID`, optional `title`, `class`, `container`, `codec`, and a `file` part. The server applies quota and disk-headroom checks, rejects hostile image headers for image uploads, encrypts the uploaded bytes before durable storage, and registers Media through the target Library catalog plane.

201.description: The upload was encrypted, deduplicated by content fingerprint, and registered as Media.

400.description: Invalid multipart request, missing fields, hostile image bytes, or rejected backup policy.

423.description: Backup ingest is paused and must be surfaced to the user.

500.description: Backup ingest failed due to an internal storage failure.

507.description: Quota or disk-headroom guard refused the upload.

get.summary: Subscribe to the server-sent event stream.
get.description: Requires the `events-subscribe` scope. A long-lived `text/event-stream` of Reveal-filtered server events (playback, library, and — for admin-scoped keys — Profile lifecycle). Event payloads carry only identifiers and state; a restricted-Media event never reaches a key that cannot Reveal it. This is an alias of the pre-existing `/api/events` route on the stable prefix; both resolve through the same `events-subscribe` gate. Reconnect with the standard `Last-Event-ID` header or the `?after=` query cursor.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume cursor: deliver only events after this sequence number.
